item.title: The AC/DC Song They’d Rather Pretend NEVER HAPPENED: 'Really Soft Stuff'
item.description: “But the answer was literally on the other side.” Back when AC/DC hadn’t yet locked in the sound that would make them gods to some and repetitive to others, they were still fumbling through the dark.
